title: Viva Glint: enhanced multi-attribute report exports
notes: claim 49: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the licence-count statement omits Microsoft's exemption for support users and could lead administrators to buy unnecessary licences. The roadmap facts, current export behaviour and administrator-assignment path are supported; the statement that survey takers see no change is not documented.

claims.claim: The licence count must be greater than or equal to the number of active users in the app, without an exemption.
claims.quote:
The total number of active licenses in your subscriptions should be greater than or equal to the number of active users in the app.
Support users don't count toward your organization's Viva Glint licenses.

claims.claim: Service Administrator assignment is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Viva > Viva Glint > Assign Glint service admin > Add users.
claims.quote:
Sign in to the Microsoft 365 admin center.
Go to Settings and select Viva.
In the list of applications, select Viva Glint.
Select Assign Glint service admin and choose Add users.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no PowerShell or Graph operation for assigning Viva Glint Service Administrators.
claims.quote: Searched: "Viva Glint" "Service" "Administrator" "API"; "Viva Glint" "PowerShell" "assign". Read post-provisioning-next-steps, role-definitions and Entra role-assignment excerpts; no Service Admin operation.

claims.claim: A Microsoft 365 Global Administrator or Viva Glint Tenant Administrator assigns Service Administrators.
claims.quote:
Users can only be added/removed to this role by a Microsoft 365 Global Administrator or a Viva Glint Tenant Administrator from the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.
PIM users assigned access through group assignment will encounter access errors until access rights are assigned through direct assignment.
claims.fix: Keep the role statement, and add its documented access qualification in Governance controls: "Viva Glint Tenant Administrators using PIM-enabled accounts must have direct assignment, not group assignment, to manage settings in the Microsoft 365 admin center." Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/glint/setup/post-provisioning-next-steps.

claims.claim: Viva Glint Service Administrators have access to all administrative functionality in the app.
claims.quote: Users in this role are the "owners" of the Viva Glint app, having access to all administrative functionality and all survey data within the app.
